szoveg_eredeti:
Bloomberg :

 Anthropic stock fell as low as $87.26 in the opening hours of its second day of trading, trimming gains from the $83 IPO price to as little as 5.1%   —  Anthropic PBC shares erased much of their first-day jump on Friday, testing investors' faith after the AI lab delivered the biggest initial public offering in history.

prioritas.lead_hu: A rekordméretű IPO után az Anthropic árfolyama 87 dollár közelébe esett vissza, ezzel jelentősen megcsappant az első napi nyereség.
